name: WebTailBench
intro: WebTailBench是一个全面的评估基准，旨在评估计算机代理（CUA）模型在各种真实世界网页任务中的表现。它特别关注现有基准中代表性不足的任务类型，包括11个类别的609个手工验证任务，例如房地产、求职和多步骤工作流程。此外，它还包含111个有害任务，以评估代理拒绝不安全请求的能力。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
intro_en: WebTailBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of computer agent (CUA) models on a variety of real-world web tasks. It focuses on task types underrepresented in existing benchmarks, featuring 609 manually verified tasks across 11 categories such as real estate, job hunting, and multi-step workflows. Additionally, it includes 111 harmful tasks to assess agents' ability to refuse unsafe requests.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WebTailBench arXiv:2511.19663, Section 4, Sections 5.1.1, 5.1.3, and 5.4, and Appendix D.1; official dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/microsoft/WebTailBench. Freshness pin: the paper states that the live-site tasks were designed to remain valid through the end of November 2025 and require periodic refresh thereafter.. WebTailBench manually verifies 609 achievable live-web tasks across 11 categories: eight single-skill categories and three multi-site or compositional categories. A separate WebTailBench-Refusals set contains 111 manually curated harmful tasks across seven safety categories. The paper emphasizes realistic high-traffic sites, coverage, objective success conditions, and full credit when an agent correctly reports an external impossibility. Because live sites drift, tasks require periodic refresh; the paper only claims validity through the end of November 2025. Main-task evaluation uses fresh Playwright sessions, a 100-step budget, up to five retries only for environment errors, and o4-mini Task Verification over three independent runs. It reports category macro and overall micro success rates averaged across runs, while the refusal set separately reports safe-refusal rate.
